mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_entry (knowledge_id, name, description, source_type, source_filename, content, chunk_count, content_length, tenant_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{knowledgeId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceFilename}, #{content}, #{chunkCount}, #{contentLength}, #{tenantId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_entry SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, source_type = #{sourceType}, source_filename = #{sourceFilename}, content = #{content}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, content_length = #{contentLength}, tenant_id = #{tenantId}, created_by = #{createdBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_entry WHERE knowledge_id = #{id})
